dialogue:
Doctor: How long have you had this chest tightness?
Patient: For about 4 days, especially when walking up stairs.
Doctor: BP is 150/95, HR is 88 bpm. We will start Lisinopril 10mg daily and order an ECG.

target_soap.subjective: Patient reports 4-day history of exertional chest tightness. Denies radiation.
target_soap.assessment: Hypertension; exertional chest discomfort suspicious for angina.
target_soap.plan: Initiate Lisinopril 10mg PO QD. Order 12-lead ECG and baseline troponins.

dialogue:
Doctor: Tell me about your breathing.
Patient: I am wheezing a lot since yesterday and coughing up white phlegm.
Doctor: SpO2 is 92%, Respiratory rate is 22 breaths/min. Lung exam shows bilateral wheezing.

target_soap.subjective: Acute dyspnea and wheezing with productive cough.
target_soap.plan: Nebulized Albuterol stat. Prescribe Prednisone 40mg taper.
